name: Ome Retro Town

en.name: Ome Retro Town
en.description: A charming historic town center lined with hand-painted classic movie billboards, retro Showa signs, and historic wooden shopfronts. It offers a nostalgic journey into mid-20th century Japanese cinema culture.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Paid public parking options available nearby.
